verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Cognee hosts a working llms.txt at https://docs.cognee.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing itself for agent consumption, and the docs also provide an MCP server for agent-native connection to tools like Claude, Cursor, Cline, and Codex. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully in practice, and no broader agent-oriented docs index beyond the single llms.txt file is evidenced.
